description: Compact exceptions-only triage: fewer KPIs and incident tables than Overview Exceptions.

targets.expr: count(((mssql_job_running_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > on(instance, job_name, category_name) group_left() (mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} * $over_avg_factor) and on(instance, job_name, category_name) (mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > 60)) or (mssql_job_running_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} >= 1800 unless on(instance, job_name, category_name) (mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > 60)))) or vector(0)

max by (availability_group_name, db, server_secondary) (last_over_time(mssql_alwayson_redo_queue_kb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) and on (availability_group_name, db, server_secondary) ((max by (availability_group_name, db, server_secondary) (last_over_time(mssql_alwayson_estimated_data_loss_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) > 30) or (max by (availability_group_name, db, server_secondary) (last_over_time(mssql_alwayson_redo_queue_remaining_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}[5m])) > 30))

((mssql_cpu_sqlserver_process_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} and on(instance) (mssql_cpu_sqlserver_process_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} <= (100 - mssql_cpu_system_idle_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}))) or on(instance) ((100 - mssql_cpu_system_idle_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"}) and on(instance) (mssql_cpu_sqlserver_process_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > (100 - mssql_cpu_system_idle_percent{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"})))) >= 70

max by (instance, db) (((mssql_backup_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", backup_type="diff"} >= 0) or ((mssql_backup_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", backup_type="diff"} < 0) * 0 + 999999999)) unless on(instance, db) (mssql_database_is_read_only{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} == 1) unless on(instance, db) (mssql_backup_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", is_read_only="1"}) unless on(instance, db) (mssql_alwayson_replica_db_synchronization_health{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="SECONDARY", is_local="1"}) unless on(instance, db) (mssql_restore_db_standby{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} == 1))

max by (instance, db) ((((mssql_backup_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", backup_type="full"} >= 0) or ((mssql_backup_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", backup_type="full"} < 0) * 0 + 999999999))) and on(instance, db) ((mssql_database_is_read_only{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} == 1) or mssql_backup_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", backup_type="full", is_read_only="1"}) unless on(instance, db) (mssql_alwayson_replica_db_synchronization_health{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", role_desc="SECONDARY", is_local="1"}) unless on(instance, db) (mssql_restore_db_standby{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} == 1))

((mssql_job_running_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > on(instance, job_name, category_name) group_left() (mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} * $over_avg_factor) and on(instance, job_name, category_name) (mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > 60)) or (mssql_job_running_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} >= 1800 unless on(instance, job_name, category_name) (mssql_job_history_avg_duration_seconds_24h{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance"} > 60)))
